clue.text: Better follow group leader

parts.note: to better someone is to top them
to dog is to follow closely

explanation.surface: An instruction to do well by trailing whoever heads the group.
explanation.definitionFit: A top dog is the dominant member of a pack, the boss of any group.

clue.text: Times look at supporting zero growth

indicators.note: in a down answer the supporting pieces sit underneath, so the zero comes on top

parts.note: O looks like zero
X is the multiplication sign, read as times
to eye is to look at

explanation.surface: A newspaper eyeing a story about no economic growth at all.
explanation.definitionFit: The oxeye is a daisy, a plant, so a growth in the botanical sense.

clue.text: Pleased having been left in the dark?

definitions.text: having been left in the dark?
definitions.meaning: second, punning meaning: ..., with the lights taken away

explanation.walkthrough: Read the word as DE- plus LIGHTED, the prefix undoing the lighting, and someone is left in darkness.
explanation.definitionFit: Delighted is the everyday adjective for being thrilled or very glad.

clue.text: Eager to attack, shooter shot across front of house

parts.note: a gun is a shooter

indicators.note: the attempt is stretched across the letter, holding it inside

parts.note: a shot is a go, an attempt

indicators.note: front of picks the first letter of house

explanation.surface: A gunman firing wildly over the front of a building.
explanation.definitionFit: Gung-ho describes someone overly enthusiastic, especially keen to fight.

clue.text: Jokes about boy and right things to wear for best

indicators.note: the jokes go round, enclosing the boy and the letter

parts.note: gags are jokes
a lad is a boy

explanation.surface: Jokes about a lad and what's proper to wear at a smart occasion.
explanation.definitionFit: Glad rags is informal for one's smartest clothes, kept for special occasions.

clue.text: Put a lot of effort into it and go with the pedal to the metal

definitions.text: Put a lot of effort into it
go with the pedal to the metal
definitions.meaning: second meaning: accelerate hard, foot flat down on the pedal

explanation.walkthrough: Welly is British slang for a wellington boot, so the phrase pictures a boot pressing hard; it means both exert yourself and drive flat out.
explanation.definitionFit: The British idiom means apply maximum force or energy, including flooring the accelerator.

clue.text: Stop a barrier crushing brother

indicators.note: the barrier squeezes the brother in its grip, holding him inside

parts.note: a gate is a barrier

explanation.surface: A sibling getting trapped by a gate swinging shut.
explanation.definitionFit: To abrogate a law or agreement is to repeal or end it formally.

clue.text: Proportion of speech missing at both ends

indicators.note: the speech loses its first and last letters

parts.note: an oration is a formal speech

explanation.surface: Complaining that some of a speech was cut off at the start and finish.
explanation.definitionFit: A ratio expresses the relative size of two quantities.

clue.text: Fashion model glad to get podium prize

indicators.note: to fashion is to shape, so the letters are reshaped

explanation.surface: A fashion model happy to receive an award on stage.
explanation.definitionFit: The winner standing on the top step of the podium receives the first-place award.

clue.text: Thoroughly at home with first lady, Republican — that is a surprise

parts.note: well means thoroughly, as in well cooked
in means at home
Eve was the first woman in Genesis

explanation.surface: A first lady, a Republican, completely at ease at home: how unexpected.
explanation.definitionFit: The exclamation is a stock response of astonishment.

clue.text: Related fact ultimately obsolete

indicators.note: ultimately picks the final letter of fact

parts.note: old means out of date, obsolete

explanation.surface: Someone recounted a fact that turned out to be out of date.
explanation.definitionFit: Related as in narrated: a story related is a story recounted.

clue.text: Discipline of Chinese with regard to flow of energy

definitions.text: Discipline of Chinese with regard to flow of energy

parts.words: Discipline of Chinese with regard to flow of energy
parts.note: describes the traditional Chinese practice of arranging surroundings for good energy flow

explanation.walkthrough: Almost a plain definition: the whole clue describes the practice.
explanation.definitionFit: The Chinese art arranges buildings and furniture to harmonise the flow of qi.

clue.text: Good facilities many essentially abandoned being dimly lit

parts.note: loo is British slang for the toilet, the facilities

indicators.note: the essential middle of many is dropped

parts.note: taken as written before its centre goes

explanation.surface: A neglected building where the toilets are mostly abandoned and dark.
explanation.walkthrough: 'essentially abandoned' removes AN, the middle letters of MANY, leaving MY.
explanation.definitionFit: A gloomy room is dark, poorly lit.

clue.text: Enthusiasm stifled by size, strangely

indicators.note: the answer is smothered inside the words that follow

explanation.surface: Someone's enthusiasm oddly held back by their bulk.
explanation.definitionFit: Zest means keen relish or gusto.

clue.text: European priest, oddly firm friend of the bishop

indicators.note: oddly takes the first, third and fifth letters of priest

parts.note: CO is the abbreviation for company, a firm
a pal is a friend

explanation.surface: A European cleric who is a loyal friend of the bishop.
explanation.definitionFit: Episcopal means relating to bishops or governed by them.

clue.text: Reserve time invested in place for pier

indicators.note: the letter is placed inside, clothed by the seaside

parts.note: piers are built at the seaside

explanation.surface: Booking some holiday time at a resort with a pier.
explanation.definitionFit: To set something aside is to keep it in reserve for later.

clue.text: Musical talent to express disappointment on walk

definitions.note: a noun phrase for the skill; the answer is the verb for using it

indicators.note: in a down answer the first piece sits on top of the second

parts.note: to sigh is to express disappointment
to tread is to walk

explanation.surface: A musician sighing at the prospect of a long walk.
explanation.definitionFit: To sight-read is to play music at first sight of the score, a prized skill.

clue.text: Protection on board secured by stablemate?

indicators.note: the answer is held fast inside the next word

explanation.surface: Seemingly about a horse sharing a stable kept safe aboard.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on board' suggests a ship, but the board is a table.
explanation.definitionFit: A table mat protects the surface of a dining table, the board, from hot dishes.

clue.text: Unusual find in friendly power supplier

indicators.note: the jumbled letters go into the friendly word

parts.note: warm means friendly

indicators.note: unusual signals the letters of find in a strange order

explanation.surface: An odd discovery at a welcoming energy company.
explanation.definitionFit: A wind farm is a group of turbines generating electricity.

clue.text: Swallow and pull back quietly

indicators.note: back signals the word is turned round

parts.note: to lug is to pull or haul
P is piano, the music term for quietly

explanation.surface: Drinking down something and then quietly withdrawing.
explanation.definitionFit: A gulp is a large swallow, or to swallow hastily.

clue.text: Creative type — one in class

indicators.note: the numeral goes inside the class

parts.note: a genus is a class in biology
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A brilliant pupil, one of a kind in a classroom.
explanation.definitionFit: A genius is someone of exceptional creative or intellectual power.

clue.text: Dash off, seeing son move slowly

parts.note: to crawl is to move slowly

explanation.surface: A parent wanting to rush away, watching a child dawdle.
explanation.definitionFit: To scrawl is to write something hastily and messily, dashing it off.

clue.text: Together or mainly by oneself — golf

indicators.note: mainly keeps most of the word, losing its last letter

parts.note: alone means by oneself
G is golf in the NATO alphabet

explanation.surface: Playing golf with others or mostly solo.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface sets together against alone; only one of them is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Along can mean in company, as in come along with us.

clue.text: Grabbing wife and taking a break

parts.note: resting means taking a break

explanation.surface: A partner snatching something while having a rest.
explanation.definitionFit: Wresting means pulling something away forcibly, seizing it.

clue.text: Part of church accepting one is innocent

indicators.note: the church part takes the numeral inside

parts.note: the nave is the main body of a church
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: Someone guiltless welcomed into a section of a church.
explanation.definitionFit: Naive means artless and unworldly, lacking experience.

clue.text: Capable of improving, stood regularly

parts.note: up means rising, improving

indicators.note: regularly takes every other letter of stood

explanation.surface: Someone getting better who has stood up from time to time.
explanation.definitionFit: Up to a task means able to manage it.

clue.text: "A way of communicating tedium" Mail involved

indicators.note: involved means intricate, tangled, so these letters are mixed up

explanation.surface: A quotation complaining that a newspaper bores its readers.
explanation.walkthrough: Mail is the Daily Mail, a British newspaper, used here only for its letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Multimedia combines text, sound and video to convey information.

clue.text: A little short in cunning

indicators.note: the short word goes inside the cunning one

parts.note: sly means cunning
light means short of the proper weight

explanation.surface: Someone a bit lacking in craftiness.
explanation.definitionFit: Slightly means to a small degree.

clue.text: Study on turf heavy with moisture

indicators.note: the study is placed after the turf

parts.note: a sod is a piece of turf
a den is a private study

explanation.surface: A study built on wet, soggy turf.
explanation.definitionFit: Sodden means thoroughly soaked, saturated.
